run_TestService_UnaryCall: run a gRPC UnaryCall that returns a SimpleResponse with a compressable payload of specified size
run_TestService_StreamingOutputCall: run a gRPC StreamingOutputCall that yields responses with configurable intervals and payload sizes
run_TestService_StreamingInputCall: run a gRPC StreamingInputCall that aggregates payload sizes from a stream of requests
run_TestService_FullDuplexCall: run a gRPC FullDuplexCall that streams responses with configurable intervals for each streamed request
run_TestService_EmptyCall: run a gRPC EmptyCall that echoes initial and trailing metadata and returns an empty response
